evidence_items.explanation: The audit supports worsening citation integrity before Marcus's post. Its narrow detection method, acknowledged false positives and uncertain attribution limit what it establishes about the magnitude of AI-induced degradation across science.
The university announcement describes growing organized scientific fraud. It discusses generative AI as an additional threat, but does not measure how much of the reported growth AI caused.
